retained_foundations: FBE7–11 compute the uncut formal-degree normalization, regular chart lifts, the singleton measure factor, the positive pivots for the radial transfer, and the leading reciprocal coefficient on a regular normal block. For the original compact arrays B8.10hbe still requires comparison of every ordered signed differential and its density-weighted adjoint, with the phase and measure on each residual slice.

The comparison must extend through singular block strata with the original annular germ bounds and terminal projected form. The signed one-pair identity is used in passing from its standard version to the arithmetic singleton in FBE9.

The original interlacing products, critical-level mass bound, representation-density majorants and whole-row absolute convergence enter on the selected arithmetic family. The scalar level-zero model uses its transfer and integrability estimates. Equal words, deficient orbits and conversion to the Hilbert–Schmidt norm are treated in the period chapter.

formal_consumer.scope: The row theorem applies a density-normalized recursion. FBE7–11 compute local measures and regular-cut identities, including the leading mixed minor. The group-to-radial operator identification on every signed word and its passage across the singular locus still enter the row theorem.
